description: Start a scene-by-scene analysis of a video. Provide url: a video link, or the url of a video the user has uploaded via upload_media/confirm_upload. Returns immediately with status='queued'; poll get_analysis until status='succeeded'. Processing typically takes 3-5 minutes on average. IMPORTANT: warn the user up front that the longer the video, the less accurate the scene-by-scene analysis becomes — short clips give the most reliable results.

start_seconds.description: Where to start analysing, in seconds.

url.description: The video's link, or the url of a video uploaded with upload_media.

name: analyze_video
title: Analyse a video
